name: @pipeworx/mcp-france-legi

tools.name: fr_code_article
tools.description: Read an article of an official French code — Code civil, Code pénal, Code du travail, Code de commerce, Code général des impôts, Code de la santé publique and the other codes in force — by code and article number, from DILA's consolidated LEGI base (the text Légifrance publishes). Returns the text in force today (or on `date`), its dates of entry into force and end, its place in the code (livre/titre/chapitre), the NOTA, and every version of the article with dates. Use for "what does article 1240 of the Code civil say", "Code du travail L1221-1", "article 121-3 du Code pénal".

code.description: The code: its title ("Code civil", "Code du travail", "Code général des impôts"), a short form ("civil", "travail", "CGI", "CPP", "CSP"), or its Légifrance cid (LEGITEXT000006070721).

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD: return the version in force on that date instead of today.

tools.name: fr_legi_search
tools.description: Full-text search across the articles in force of the French codes (DILA LEGI consolidated text) — find which article of French law deals with a subject, in French: "responsabilité du fait des choses", "licenciement pour motif économique", "abus de biens sociaux". Optional `code` restricts to one code. Returns ranked articles with code, number, section path and an excerpt; quote a phrase for an exact phrase match.

query.description: Words or a "quoted phrase", in French. Accents optional.

code.description: Optional — restrict to one code. The code: its title ("Code civil", "Code du travail", "Code général des impôts"), a short form ("civil", "travail", "CGI", "CPP", "CSP"), or its Légifrance cid (LEGITEXT000006070721).

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD: only articles in force on that date (default today).

tools.name: fr_code_toc
tools.description: Table of contents of a French code in force (parties, livres, titres, chapitres, sections) with the article numbers under each heading, from DILA's LEGI consolidated base. `depth` controls how many levels come back; pass a `section_id` from a previous answer to expand one branch. Use to browse the structure of the Code civil, Code du travail, Code de commerce, etc., or to list the articles of a chapter.

code.description: The code: its title ("Code civil", "Code du travail", "Code général des impôts"), a short form ("civil", "travail", "CGI", "CPP", "CSP"), or its Légifrance cid (LEGITEXT000006070721).

section_id.description: Optional LEGISCTA id of a section to expand (from a previous fr_code_toc answer).

depth.description: Levels to return below the starting point, 1-8 (default 2).

tools.name: fr_article_versions
tools.description: Version history of an article of a French code: every consolidated version with its dates of entry into force and end, its status (VIGUEUR, MODIFIE, ABROGE…) and its text, from DILA's LEGI base. Pass a LEGIARTI `id`, or `code` + `article`. Use for "how has article L1237-19 of the Code du travail changed", "what did article 1382 of the Code civil say before 2016".

id.description: A LEGIARTI id, e.g. LEGIARTI000032041571 (any version of the article).

code.description: With article, instead of id. The code: its title ("Code civil", "Code du travail", "Code général des impôts"), a short form ("civil", "travail", "CGI", "CPP", "CSP"), or its Légifrance cid (LEGITEXT000006070721).

article.description: With code, instead of id: the article number, e.g. "1240".

include_text.description: Include each version's text (default true; the 20 most recent versions).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-france-legi forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the france-legi pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
